title: L1 학습 모델의 원래 해상도 관측 오차 분석과 관측 일치 사영
question: Experiments 63 (L1) and 65 (L1 + spectral loss) failed the FR observation guard (RMSE ratio 1.32 and 1.47 against 53 C2MS) while FR_WALD and FR D_lambda improved. Where does the extra observation error come from, and can the experiment 45 exact observation-consistency projection remove it without losing the RR gains?
data: QB RR and FR test, 20 scenes each (local data/test, same files as the server evaluation)
metrics: same as the server evaluation of 53/54/63/65: rr_metrics on RR, RR2 (54 Wald degradation of the RR input, RR MS as reference) and FR_WALD (degradation of the FR input, FR MS as reference); fr_metrics and observation RMSE (interior, margin 5) on FR
operators: 54 Wald operators (QB MS/PAN MTF, 41 taps, replicate border, decimation phase 2) evaluated with FFT; checked against the direct form on random 96x96 inputs (max abs difference recorded in results/analysis_s<seed>.json)
projection: experiment 45: y' = y + D^T M^T (M D D^T M^T)^-1 M (MS - D y), interior mask margin 5 (P5), CG per band in float64, relative tolerance 1e-8, at most 400 iterations, applied at every inference (RR, RR2, FR_WALD and FR inputs)
decomposition: e = D(y) - MS on the interior: per-band mean bias; low band = D(lowpass(y)) - MS with an ideal FFT lowpass at 1/8 cycles/pixel (MS Nyquist); high band (aliasing) = D(y - lowpass(y)); e = low band + high band
images: common/result_images.py on the fixed six QB RR scenes, 65 L1 + spectral without vs with projection (visual check of the projection, not a baseline comparison)
limits: seeds 42 and 43 (44 after experiment 65 finishes); post-hoc analysis on the test set already used for exploration; the projection is an inference-time step (about 108 CG iterations per image), not a trained model; no validation-based selection
